title.en: Express questionnaire on the readiness of a site for investment

documents.description: The current charter of the client's company.

checks: It is a company charter (Устав / Устав), not another document.
The company name matches the client's company, if it is known.
It shows that it was approved and registered (date, founders' decision, registration mark or QR code).

documents.description: An extract from the unified state register of enterprises and organisations (ЕГРПО).

checks: It is an extract from the state register of legal entities (ЕГРПО, issued by the state services centre or my.gov.uz).
The company name and STIR (INN) are shown and match the client's company, if it is known; the head is named.
It is recent: issued no more than 3 months before today.

title.uz: Yer qa'ridan foydalanish uchun elektron ruxsatnoma

documents.description: The electronic permit for the right to use a subsoil plot (рухсатнома / разрешение), issued by the Subsoil Use Centre under the law ZRU-987.

title.uz: Yer qa'ridan foydalanish uchun elektron ruxsatnoma

checks: It is a subsoil use permit (рухсатнома / разрешение на право пользования участком недр), usually with a QR code, not a licence or another document.
It has a number, an issue date and the holder; the holder matches the client's company, if known.
It is not expired today (if a validity date is shown).

title.uz: Yer qa'ridan foydalanish uchun elektron litsenziya

documents.description: The electronic licence for subsoil use (лицензия), for example one issued before the law ZRU-987 or through license.gov.uz.

title.uz: Yer qa'ridan foydalanish uchun elektron litsenziya

checks: It is a subsoil use licence (лицензия / литсензия на пользование недрами), usually with a QR code or a license.gov.uz number.
It has a number, an issue date and the holder; the holder matches the client's company, if known.
It is not expired and not revoked today (if a validity date or status is shown).

documents.description: The licence agreement / subsoil use conditions (шартнома) under Cabinet of Ministers resolution No. 133.

checks: It is a licence agreement or subsoil use conditions document (лицензия келишуви / лицензионное соглашение / ер қаъридан фойдаланиш шартлари / шартнома).
It names the subsoil user and refers to the permit, licence or plot.
It is signed (signature, electronic signature or QR code).

documents.description: УТЭР (укрупнённый технико-экономический расчёт): the consolidated technical and economic calculation for the deposit.

checks: It is an UTER / УТЭР (укрупнённый технико-экономический расчёт), not a full feasibility study or another project.
It names the deposit, site or company.
It has a date and the developer, or an approval / agreement mark.

documents.description: The feasibility study of the project (ТИА / ТЭО / техник-иқтисодий асослаш).

checks: It is a feasibility study (ТИА / ТЭО / техник-иқтисодий асослаш).
It names the deposit, site or company.
It shows an approval, agreement or expert review mark, or at least a date and the developer.

documents.description: The mining allotment project (тоғ ажратмаси лойиҳаси / проект горного отвода) with the boundaries of the allotment.

checks: It is a mining allotment project or mining allotment act (тоғ ажратмаси / горный отвод).
It names the deposit, site or company and shows the allotment boundaries (coordinates, area or plan).
It has a date and an approval or agreement mark, or at least the developer.

documents.description: A document confirming that the annual geological report form 5-GR was submitted to the State Fund of geological information.

checks: It is form 5-GR (5-ГР) with an acceptance mark, or a receipt / letter confirming that it was submitted.
It shows the reporting year and the company or site.
The reporting year is the last or the year before last.

documents.description: ЗВОС (заявление о воздействии на окружающую среду / атроф-муҳитга таъсир тўғрисида ариза): the draft environmental impact statement, or the state environmental expert review conclusion on it.

checks: It is a ZVOS / ЗВОС / ОВОС (environmental impact statement) or the state environmental expert review conclusion on it.
It names the site or the company.
For an expert review conclusion: it is positive and not expired (3 years for EIA materials).

documents.description: ЗЭП (заявление об экологических последствиях / экологик оқибатлар тўғрисида ариза): the statement on environmental consequences, the final stage of the EIA, or the state environmental expert review conclusion on it.

checks: It is a ZEP / ЗЭП (statement on environmental consequences) or the state environmental expert review conclusion on it.
It names the site or the company.
For an expert review conclusion: it is positive and not expired (3 years for EIA materials).

documents.description: ПДВ (предельно допустимые выбросы): the project of maximum permissible emissions into the air, or the expert review conclusion on it.

checks: It is a PDV / ПДВ project (maximum permissible emissions) or the environmental expert review conclusion on it.
It names the site or the company.
For an expert review conclusion: it is positive and not expired (5 years for environmental standards).

documents.description: Environmental limits: the waste generation and disposal limits project, PDS (permissible discharges) or water use limits, or the expert review conclusion on them.

checks: It is a limits document: waste generation / disposal limits project, PDS / ПДС (permissible discharges), water use limits, or the environmental expert review conclusion on one of them.
It names the site or the company.
For an expert review conclusion: it is positive and not expired (5 years for environmental standards).

title.uz: OPO bo'yicha sanoat xavfsizligi ekspertizasi (EPB) dalolatnomalari
title.ru: Акты экспертизы промышленной безопасности (ЭПБ) по ОПО
title.en: Industrial safety expert review (EPB) reports for hazardous facilities

documents.description: Industrial safety expert review reports / conclusions (ЭПБ) for the hazardous production facilities (ОПО).

title.uz: OPO bo'yicha sanoat xavfsizligi ekspertizasi (EPB) dalolatnomalari
title.ru: Акты экспертизы промышленной безопасности (ЭПБ) по ОПО
title.en: Industrial safety expert review (EPB) reports for hazardous facilities

checks: It is an industrial safety expert review conclusion or report (ЭПБ / саноат хавфсизлиги экспертизаси), a registration of a hazardous production facility (ОПО) or a permit to operate it.
It names the company or the facility.
It has a number and a date and comes from an accredited expert organisation or the competent authority.

documents.description: Decisions on the land allotment for the site (hokim's decision, land lease agreement or cadastre document).

checks: It is a land allotment decision (hokim's decision / қарор / решение), a land lease agreement or a cadastre document for the site.
It names the company and the plot (area, location).
It has a number and a date.

documents.description: The express questionnaire itself (Uzbek or Russian version), filled in, with its non-disclosure agreement (NDA / owner's consent block) signed by the owner. It also gives the company name.

checks: It is this questionnaire (title 'ЭКСПРЕСС-АНКЕТА' / 'ЭКСПРЕСС-АНКЕТАСИ') with its NDA block, or the organisation's NDA signed separately, not another document.
Company name, full name and position of the person who filled it in, contact phone or Telegram, and the name of the deposit / subsoil plot are filled in (not blank lines or underscores).
Direction A (geological exploration) or B (mining / gold) is marked in step 1, and in each of the 10 items of step 2 one option is marked or the item is marked as not applicable (NA).
The NDA (owner's consent block) has the position, a signature and a date. A stamp is welcome but not required.
